lead_raw_text:
The structure of U6Si2 (U3Si) crystallizes in the hexagonal space group P6_3/mmc (No. 194), with 8 atoms per unit cell distributed over 2 independent Wyckoff orbits. Geometry-derived analysis shows both Si and U centers in close-packed-like local arrangements with 12 geometric neighbors per center atom, where each U is surrounded by 8 Si and 4 U neighbors, and each Si by 12 U neighbors. The geometric neighbor graph is three-dimensional and connected across all 8 sites. Validated polyhedron-sharing relations include corner, edge, and face sharing among U-centered 12-vertex polyhedra, and edge sharing between Si- and U-centered polyhedra.
